sources.note: registrant DIGITAL REALTY TRUST, INC., matched 2026-10-08

profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a data center company that describes itself as delivering the world's largest data center platform, offering colocation, interconnection, connectivity and cloud services across a global ecosystem. The company says it serves deployments ranging from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and describes itself as sustainably built for flexibility, open ecosystems and reach. It is headquartered in Austin, Texas, trades under the ticker DLR, and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001297996.

On AI, the company's site frames the market as one where AI is exposing infrastructure gaps, with inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It also promotes a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, citing that 40% of IT leaders name infrastructure as an AI constraint and describing how enterprises are moving from AI strategy to execution.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 126.
